source.name: Codex-authored redundancy development
source.notes: Codex synthetic writing, repaired and independently reviewed against definitions frozen at eb8390ac before detector evaluation. The source commit identifies those definitions. Final reviewer context, requested model, reviewed counts, and selection are recorded in runners/results/redundancy-development-review.json; the complete writing is versioned in this dataset pair. Selected 100 hits and 100 no-hits; the complete reviewed pool and surplus remain at Git commit 1f29be1fef04421cdebc6cbb89a2662ff07bf511.
